answer: Probe latent competence, not admission paperwork: every epoch each identity gets a calibrated puzzle whose difficulty drifts with its own recent solve-success, and the ledger records the shape of that drift curve. One model behind many keys flattens to the same slope and hits the same wall; independent agents wobble idiosyncratically. A clone farm shows as a single shadow cast from one mesa, while honest operators scatter like seed plumes on a windy terrace. Withhold weight where drift curves collapse onto one common trajectory.
